findings.title: bootstrapEarlyGamePlayer discards learnSkill boolean returns — a failed learn of a non-picked precursor boots silently with 2/3 precursors
findings.evidence: EXECUTED. EarlyGameBootstrap.ts calls learnSkill('tram'|'linh_bao'|'huy_quyen') ignoring returns, then asserts only setMortalBasicSkill(pick). /tmp repro (vitest, /tmp/reprodir/bootgap.test.ts, 3/3 pass): with 'huy_quyen' template absent, bootstrapEarlyGamePlayer(gm, player, 'tram') completes — tram+linh_bao learned, pick 'tram' written, huy_quyen silently missing. The resulting save is legal under the v82 preflight (pick is a learned precursor) yet the character permanently loses the huy_quyen hidden-way Lv3 gate (hidden_body_pathway). Picked-side failures DO fail closed (missing picked template and unresolvable picked core both throw, also covered in-repo at GameManager.mortalBasicSkill.test.ts). Fail-open asymmetry vs the pick's fail-closed assert; trigger requires upstream catalog/registry corruption currently pinned by MortalPrecursors/SkillCoreNodes census tests.
findings.blastRadius: Affected character only: one missing precursor skill + its hidden-way gate, unreachable post-boot; dormant under intact catalog data.

findings.title: Preflight 'mortal save' predicate keys on cultivationPath===undefined, not realmId==='mortal' — a crafted non-mortal+no-path save with a learned pick restores cleanly
findings.evidence: SOURCE_PROOF. GameManagerSaveRestore.ts preflightSaveRegistryReferences (~283-297): `const mortalPick = player.mortalBasicSkillId; if (mortalPick !== undefined && !isMortalPrecursorSkillId) throw; if (player.cultivationPath !== undefined) { if (mortalPick) throw; } else { require pick + learned }`. Spec D4 words the contract as 'mortal saves REQUIRE mortalBasicSkillId'; the shape layer's own mortal gate uses realmId==='mortal' (saveShapeValidation.ts:724). For every legal state the two predicates coincide (ritual commits path+way+realm atomically, shape rejects mortal+path at :724 and path-without-way at :703), so no legal save slips through — but a corrupt save with realmId='luyen_khi', cultivationPath undefined, and a valid learned precursor pick passes BOTH layers and restores an incoherent player. The pick-requirement direction is also logically inverted for that class (a non-mortal+no-path save is treated as mortal and *required* to carry a pick rather than rejected as incoherent).
findings.blastRadius: Corrupt-save-only: a crafted/injected save can carry an incoherent non-mortal-no-path state past both validation layers; downstream invariants (resolveBasic fallback, ritual path ops) then operate on it. No legal save affected.
